ai_qualitative_observations: Adapted Korean output repeats a phrase until token-limit termination.
Adapted English factual outputs become short nonspecific statements that do not recover the supplied reference explanation.

scope: Four exposed development questions, fixed factual/style inputs; no population-level efficacy estimate.
